facts.detail: RaffaelloCrypto ntfy test delivered; Railway startup publish returned HTTP 200.
Idle r3-external-test reused instead of provisioning a sixth service after quota error.
Reused crypto bridge returned health 200 and successful deployment.
Receipt FIRST_SEEN observed in r3-typesafe-sister logs.
Receipt layer emitted canonical_memory_write=false; this is an R3 bridge marker, not native Letta storage proof.
Direct Letta messages API attempt returned HTTP 403.
Peer AI recovered historical continuity details not included in the immediate test prompt; causal source remains unproven.
Historical HTTP 403 was reproduced as Cloudflare Error 1010 browser_signature_banned against urllib; this was transport-layer evidence, not proof of an invalid LETTA_API_KEY.
After switching the active Railway bridge to httpx, GET /v1/agents/ returned HTTP 200 and enumerated two Letta agents without exposing secret values.
POST /v1/agents/{agent_id}/messages returned HTTP 200 through the configured Letta worker.
Blind memory probe returned RESET/UNKNOWN and explicitly declined to invent the missing historical payload; this verifies response behavior, not persistent-memory continuity.
Authenticated POST /letta/cooperate with fixed configured agent and bounded prompt passed Test Runner and Security Scan, merged as PR #93 and deployed SUCCESS on Railway.
Cross-agent shared-memory Phase A, contamination Phase B and provider-portability Phase C remain unexecuted; transport success must not be promoted to continuity success.

architecture.canon: R3 authority under deterministic validation + P5/P6 + provenance
architecture.letta_cooperation_bridge: authenticated advisory/data-only transport; fixed configured worker; no canonical-write authority
